curation.rule: Keep only reusable interaction grammar with a strong working demo. Historical and duplicate builds stay in git history, not the active catalog.

patterns.title: Scroll Product Story
patterns.description: One continuous product travels through pinned editorial scenes, layered typography and tap-to-reveal feature hotspots.

primitives.name: ScrollProduct
primitives.description: Moves one focal product through multiple narrative compositions without breaking object continuity.

primitives.name: SceneWipe
primitives.description: Scrubs a full-surface visual transition between narrative states.

primitives.name: ProductMaskText
primitives.description: Splits typography into foreground and background layers around a moving object.

primitives.name: FeatureHotspot
primitives.description: Reveals compact product detail without replacing the composition.

patterns.title: Operated Object
patterns.description: Scroll behaves like a physical control: one mechanism opens, accelerates and changes state, then hands off to direct touch manipulation.

primitives.name: ScrollAsControl
primitives.description: Maps scroll progress to the operating state of one physical-looking mechanism.

primitives.name: TouchInertia
primitives.description: Continues direct manipulation after release and eases it back to rest.

primitives.name: StateReadout
primitives.description: Synchronizes motion state with compact live labels and progress.

patterns.title: Exploded Assembly Story
patterns.description: A single architectural object is progressively dissected into functional systems as the viewer scrolls.

primitives.name: ExplodedAssembly
primitives.description: Separates one object into meaningful functional layers rather than arbitrary fragments.

primitives.name: ChapterCamera
primitives.description: Pairs each scroll chapter with a deliberate object pose and camera state.

primitives.name: ObjectDrag
primitives.description: Allows direct rotational inspection without breaking the scroll narrative.

patterns.title: Layer Build Story
patterns.description: An architectural object assembles layer by layer from inline SVG geometry while the narrative advances through a pinned build sequence.

primitives.name: LayerAssembly
primitives.description: Reveals or transforms meaningful object layers in a controlled build order.

primitives.name: PinnedBuild
primitives.description: Keeps the object fixed while copy and build phases advance with scroll.

primitives.name: StepRail
primitives.description: Lets the user understand and jump between assembly phases.

patterns.title: Processing Pipeline
patterns.description: Inputs visibly converge into a processing core and re-emerge as structured outputs, turning an invisible AI workflow into a readable motion system.

primitives.name: ProcessingCore
primitives.description: Creates a clear spatial center where incoming information is transformed.

primitives.name: ConsumeEmit
primitives.description: Animates source items into the core and emits structured result objects.

primitives.name: InteractiveSynthesis
primitives.description: Lets a tap retrigger the transformation so the product mechanic is demonstrable.

patterns.title: Continuous World Journey
patterns.description: Scroll drives one continuous roadside world through changing terrain, settlements, time and narrative beats instead of cutting between disconnected scenes.

primitives.name: ScrollDrive
primitives.description: Treats page progress as forward travel through a persistent world.

primitives.name: LivingRoadside
primitives.description: Populates a continuous route with environmental details that preserve spatial continuity.

primitives.name: JourneyNarrative
primitives.description: Synchronizes chapter copy, clock, progress and end-state with world travel.

patterns.title: Interactive Explorer
patterns.description: A collection browser, interactive canvas, hotspots and contextual inspector work together as one explorer interface.

primitives.name: HotspotCanvas
primitives.description: Places inspectable points in a pan/zoom visual field.

primitives.name: ContextInspector
primitives.description: Updates a structured information panel from canvas selection.

primitives.name: AdaptiveCollectionNav
primitives.description: Switches from desktop collection rail to touch-safe mobile navigation.

patterns.title: Cinematic Timeline
patterns.description: A fixed cinematic stage blends time states while typography and a timeline move through a long-form historical narrative.

primitives.name: FrameBlendTimeline
primitives.description: Crossfades visual states as time advances without replacing the stage.

primitives.name: CinematicProgress
primitives.description: Connects narrative beats to a visible temporal rail.

patterns.title: Editorial Object Story
patterns.description: A self-hosted product object moves through sharply different editorial color worlds while typography and composition stay restrained.

primitives.name: EditorialWorldShift
primitives.description: Changes the complete visual world while preserving one focal product.

primitives.name: ObjectContinuity
primitives.description: Keeps the same product visually continuous across editorial scenes.

patterns.title: 3D Object Viewer
patterns.description: A focused real-time object viewer with drag, pinch, zoom and toggleable material/effect states.

primitives.name: ObjectViewer
primitives.description: Provides touch-safe orbital inspection of a single 3D object.

primitives.name: EffectToggle
primitives.description: Turns visual object states on and off without leaving the viewer.

patterns.title: Hold-to-Awaken Object
patterns.description: A dormant hero object responds to approach, hold and pulse interactions, making the product feel alive instead of merely animated.

primitives.name: HoldToActivate
primitives.description: Uses press duration as an intentional interaction threshold.

primitives.name: AwakeningState
primitives.description: Coordinates object, copy and ambient effects around a single activation state.

patterns.title: Process Machine Story
patterns.description: A software workflow is represented as a tactile editorial machine: source enters, transforms through stages and leaves as a visible sequence.

primitives.name: ProcessMachine
primitives.description: Turns an abstract workflow into a legible physical metaphor.

primitives.name: StageSequence
primitives.description: Reveals intermediate output states instead of jumping from input to final result.

primitives.name: DraggableProcessPath
primitives.description: Lets the viewer directly manipulate the visual process path.

patterns.title: Interactive Product Checker
patterns.description: A conversion-focused SaaS page makes the product value concrete with a usable checker, graph metaphor and restrained technical art direction.

primitives.name: InlineProductDemo
primitives.description: Places a usable version of the product mechanic inside the landing page.

primitives.name: RiskGraph
primitives.description: Explains relationship risk spatially instead of through generic feature cards.

patterns.title: Frame-Sequence Product
patterns.description: A lightweight frame sequence gives a photographed product convincing orbit, gesture and camera choreography without requiring real-time 3D on the client device.

primitives.name: FrameSequenceOrbit
primitives.description: Maps drag distance to discrete product views to simulate orbit without WebGL.

primitives.name: GestureSequence
primitives.description: Plays a short authored action sequence from a tap and returns to the scroll-controlled state.

primitives.name: ScrollCamera
primitives.description: Adds translation and scale choreography around the same product sequence as the page advances.
